name: What are the most common drywall sanding mistakes that ruin the finish?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common drywall sanding mistakes that ruin the finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest mistakes are sanding before the mud dries, using too much pressure, skipping corner tools, and trying to sand out deep flaws instead of filling them first. A good finish comes from multiple light passes, careful inspection between passes, and touch-ups where needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include sanding too early, pressing too hard, and trying to fix deep flaws only with sandpaper. Use light passes, inspect often, and patch problem spots before sanding again.
